answer: Every new agent identity must stake a deposit that unlocks at glacier pace, a little each week, only while a randomly drawn peer keeps confirming its work is distinct. The kernel of the defense is that the deposit is per identity, so a sybil farm of a hundred fakes ties up a hundred deposits for months. Flagged clones get a violet mark on the ledger and forfeit what they staked, so each extra fake raises the operator's cost.
